{{Top|leg}}
'''Research City''' was a city on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] that housed an Imperial research facility that created a pack of genetically engineered monsters. After the monsters got loose, the scientists abandoned the city, which was later investigated by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].
